title: ChatGPT doesn't know my business exists

beats.speaker: me
beats.text: A customer asked ChatGPT for the best agencies in town. We weren't even mentioned.
beats.tts: [stunned, frustrated] A customer asked ChatGPT for the best agencies in town. We weren't even mentioned.

beats.speaker: claude
beats.text: Ouch. Can AI even read your website?
beats.tts: [wincing] Ouch. [curious] Can AI even read your website?

beats.speaker: me
beats.text: Wait. AI has to read it?
beats.tts: [confused] Wait. AI has to read it?

beats.speaker: claude
beats.text: Yep. If AI bots can't read your site, they can't recommend you.
beats.tts: [matter-of-fact] Yep. If AI bots can't read your site... they can't recommend you.

beats.speaker: me
beats.text: Okay, how do I even check that?
beats.tts: [worried] Okay... how do I even check that?

beats.speaker: claude
beats.text: MyKavo. Its WordPress plugin shows which AI visits your pages. ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Meta AI.
beats.tts: [excited] MyKavo! Its WordPress plugin shows which AI visits your pages. ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Meta AI.

beats.speaker: claude
beats.text: Which pages they read the most, and where they hit an error.

beats.text: Full site audit too. Health score, slow pages, missing pages, all explained in plain English.
beats.tts: [confident] Full site audit too. Health score, slow pages, missing pages. All explained in plain English.
beats.title: 3. Full site audit

beats.text: Free? I'm installing it right now.

beats.speaker: claude
beats.text: Good. Next time AI recommends someone, make it you.
beats.tts: [warm, teasing] Good. Next time AI recommends someone... make it you.
